description: Subjects, exposures, outcomes, confounders. Dose-response, survival decay, biomarker trajectories, multi-test landscapes.

characteristic_patterns.name: Dose-response curve
characteristic_patterns.signature: monotonic or sigmoid response of outcome vs dose
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: symbolic discovery winner in {sigmoid, saturation, logistic}

characteristic_patterns.name: Survival decay
characteristic_patterns.signature: exponential or Weibull survival vs time
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: symbolic discovery winner in {weibull, exponential, gompertz}

characteristic_patterns.name: Treatment-effect heterogeneity
characteristic_patterns.signature: effect size differs across covariate strata
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: regime detection on outcome conditioned on covariate

characteristic_patterns.name: Multiple-testing landscape
characteristic_patterns.signature: many tests; uncorrected p-values clustered near 0

action_library.label: Prioritise hypothesis for follow-up
action_library.description: Promote the relationship with highest effect size + lowest FDR-adjusted p-value to a confirmatory experiment.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: ≈55% of pre-registered follow-ups confirm in independent samples.

action_library.label: Apply multiple-comparison correction
action_library.description: When ≥ 10 hypothesis tests run on the same dataset, apply BH-FDR or Bonferroni to the reported p-values before any narrative claims significance.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Correction collapses ≈70% of nominal significances on noisy data.
assumptions: tests are exchangeable enough for FDR

action_library.label: Design replication study
action_library.description: Specify sample size and pre-registered analysis plan to confirm a flagged finding.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Pre-registered replications confirm ≈40-60% of original findings.
